preconditions.description: The length of the ciphered text must be between 1 and 10,000.
The number of words must be between 1 and 100,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= len(wi) <= 1000 for wi in words)
preconditions.description: Each word must have a length between 1 and 1,000.
The total length of all words must not exceed 1,000,000.

postconditions.description: The output must be the original sentence formed by the words from the list.

postconditions.expression: all(word in words for word in original_sentence)
postconditions.description: All words in the original sentence must be from the provided list of words.
The length of the original sentence must match the length of the ciphered text.
